messages:
zoe: Quick note  noticed higher variance in score distributions this quarter. QA flagged inconsistent use of the new rubric fields (problem-solving vs approach).

dev: saw that too. Some interviewers still use old shorthand comments instead of the structured fields.

marcos: can we run a 25-min calibration session and a 1-pager cheat-sheet? Quick wins: 1) example answers per band, 2) mapping of old shorthand -> rubric field.

zoe: agree. propose Tue or Wed lunch meetup 25m. Also add a small GH hook that warns if a scorecard is submitted with >2 free-text comments and empty structured scores.

abby: +1 on the hook. I can draft the cheat-sheet and example answers.

recruiting-bot: poll created: Tue 12:30, Tue 17:00, Wed 12:30. Vote in thread.

dev: voted Tue 12:30. also opened infra ticket to add warning hook (INFRA-2245).

marcos: drafted agenda: 1) quick rubric walkthrough (5m) 2) group calibration on 3 anonymized snippets (15m) 3) Q+A + next steps (5m).

abby: cheat-sheet draft posted: https://internal/docs/interviewer_cheatsheet_v1. Please comment.

zoe: perfect. once poll settles, abby please send invite and add the cheat-sheet link. dev, can you add the GH hook as non-blocking alert?

dev: will add non-blocking alert to the submit workflow and post a Slack message to #people-ops when triggered.

recruiting-bot: poll results: Tue 12:30 selected (18 votes). Invite queueing.

abby: calendar invite sent to eng interviewers + recruiters for Tue 12:30. Posted checklist in #people-ops.

zoe: thank you. follow-ups: 1) dev to deploy hook by EOW; 2) abby to finalize cheat-sheet after feedback; 3) we'll run a small post-session audit of 30 recent scorecards to check for improvement. Closing once hook live and cheat-sheet final. :white_check_mark:
